training_sampling: deterministic np.linspace first-to-last, maximum 350 per trip; no label-dependent sampling
fit_data: TRAIN only; all80 trips; no student_test fitting
preprocessing: No learned preprocessing; deterministic numerical features
training_weighting: inverse candidate count per observation and inverse sampled observation count per trip, normalized to mean1
emission_policy: clip binary positive probabilities to [1e-7,1-1e-7], normalize within candidate set; graph/GPS only

proxy_label_policy.name: nearest-reference-segment-with-motion-orientation-v1
proxy_label_policy.description: Project each GPS observation onto every distinct canonical directed reference-route segment; minimise distance squared plus 32m^2 times reliable signed heading mismatch. Motion uses at most +/-3 rows and never crosses a >20s local dropout. Route data is used ONLY to create labels or score completed predictions, never features.
proxy_label_policy.limitations: No per-observation labels were supplied. Intersections, stops, nearby parallel roads, repeated traversals and route defects can make these proxy labels uncertain; these metrics are not independently verified GPS ground truth. The geometry-derived target favours geometric predictors.

student_test_observation_metrics.edge_class_namespace: trip_id:canonical_directed_original_arc_id; class union includes reference-only and prediction-only roads
student_test_observation_metrics.categorical_log_loss_policy: Normalize binary positive probabilities within each observation; absent target receives zero mass and finite log score uses floor1e-7. This is an emission log score, not a calibration claim. Misses are included in the unconditional score.
student_test_observation_metrics.continuity_definition: Adjacent available observation assignments are continuous iff same canonical edge OR head(previous)==tail(current); no routed connectors. Empty assignments count discontinuous. Includes observed time gaps; on downsampled CV this would not imply every intervening road was predicted.

cv_observation_metrics.edge_class_namespace: trip_id:canonical_directed_original_arc_id; class union includes reference-only and prediction-only roads
cv_observation_metrics.categorical_log_loss_policy: Normalize binary positive probabilities within each observation; absent target receives zero mass and finite log score uses floor1e-7. This is an emission log score, not a calibration claim. Misses are included in the unconditional score.

selection.objective: equal-trip mean OOF observation top1 proxy accuracy

hardware.timing_clock: time.perf_counter wall seconds; shared host contention possible
hardware.recorded_source: platform/os.sysconf plus CPU model from procfs

final_oof_export.purpose: retain selected configuration OOF arrays, not a new HPO trial

recovery: Only missing final fits recovered from exact caches; completed CV/HPO preserved; final model frozen before remaining baselines.
